name: Brockhaus Capital Management AG
summary: Brockhaus Capital Management AG operates as a technology holding company that acquires and holds majority stakes in growth companies in the German speaking region. The company invests in IHSE Group, a manufacturer of IT infrastructure components for the transmission of mission-critical data; and Palas GmbH, a developer and manufacturer of high-precision devices for generating, measuring, and characterizing particles in air. Brockhaus Capital Management AG was founded in 2017 and is based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany.
